data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was approximately GBP 144.53m (note). The report highlights significant 2017 catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California wildfires) which drove gross losses in 2017, while also noting movements in claims development. The document does not provide a clear single-line gross prioryear reserve movement amount; therefore a quantified prioryear development (gross) could not be extracted with confidence from the available pages. Named 2017 catastrophes are cited as primary drivers of claims activity, and both favourable development and large-loss activity are referenced in the reserves commentary.

data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as images with limited resolution. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from technical reserves note 'At 1 January 2017' (page 28). No unambiguous gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found in the readable text; the claims development triangle appears in the report but could not be reliably digitised from the provided images. Segmental premium breakout (exact statutory class names and amounts) could not be confidently extracted from the images. Where explicit gross figures were unavailable, fields have been left null and confidence scores set low. If higher-fidelity images or the original PDF text are supplied, a more precise extraction (including prior-year development from the movement note or triangle and the full premium mix) can be provided.
